candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory STATUS_CODE_ERROR timeout across multiple correlation IDs, consistent with the ~2s gateway durations.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs excluded; cannot confirm whether timeout stems from redis saturation, network, or inventory client config.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway checkout 502, matching the ~2s alert durations. Topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Metrics show checkout 502s and elevated p95 latency. Redis-side telemetry is unavailable, so root cause within redis is bounded but not fully confirmed.
